config.rollbackmod.title: Rollback Mod Settings
config.rollbackmod.enable_death_rollback: Roll back to the latest checkpoint on death.
config.rollbackmod.destroy_all_cores_on_: Remove all cores from inventories and inhalers after a rollback.
config.rollbackmod.rollback_all_players_: Roll Back All Players on Death
When any player dies, roll back every online player.

config.rollbackmod.dontgethurt_integrati: When enabled, shared damage is handed to DontGetHurt's body-part system (no effect if that mod is absent).
config.rollbackmod.show_day_hud.tooltip: Show the current day in the top-left corner (Day X / X days remaining).
config.rollbackmod.countdown_mode.toolti: false: show the current world day. true: show remaining days and trigger tower-like destruction at zero.
